The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Accessibility Audit:

The provided text describes a significant accessibility barrier. Presenting critical information, such as real-time bus and train schedules, exclusively in a graphical format without accompanying text descriptions violates core web accessibility standards, specifically WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.1.1 (Non-text Content). Screen readers cannot interpret images or graphics, meaning users who are blind or have low vision are completely excluded from accessing this essential public service information.

To make this content accessible, the graphical schedules should be replaced with or supplemented by machine-readable text, such as HTML tables or structured data lists. Additionally, if images are retained for visual reference, they must include descriptive alternative text (alt text) that conveys the same information, although text-based formats are generally preferred for dynamic data like schedules. The text itself uses inclusive language by referring to "individuals using screen readers," which is appropriate and respectful.
